description.text: Teaching Objectives To turn out highly-qualified professionals armed with a sound basic knowledge of theories and expertise in international economy and trade, familiar with the latest developments in the field of international trade of the modern world, able to handle international business and economic cooperation, and qualified for careers in business, management, research, as well as publicity in economic and trade organizations. Main Courses International Trade Practice, International Trade, International Finance, International Investment, International Marketing, Microeconomics, Macroeconomics, etc. Internship They will be able to handle international business and economic cooperation. Degree Awarded Bachelor’s Degree in Economics Future Career They will be qualified for careers in business, management, research, as well as publicity in economic and trade organizations.

duration.text: The International Economy and Trade at Wuhan University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3055 USD/per year ￥ 22000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Certificate of HSK (No need for English-medium program) Certificate of HSK (Chinese Proficiency Test) 2. Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included 3. Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant 4. High school academic transcript 5. High school graduate certificate Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization.

requirements.text: 1. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport 2. Above the age of 18 and under the age of 30 3. Those who apply for the study of liberal arts and have passed at least HSK Examination Band 6, can directly start their study in the relevant colleges or departments; those who fail to pass the examination can at first apply for their study of Chinese Language for one year in Wuhan University before their study in the relevant colleges or departments.
